works.title: Shadowlight Chronicles
works.description: A narrative-driven 2D platformer where players toggle between realms of light and shadow to solve puzzles and uncover the story of a forgotten warrior.

works.title: Echoes of the Deep
works.description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler set in an underwater city. Players customize their submarine and explore procedurally generated depths filled with mysteries and sea creatures.

works.title: Petal Quest
works.description: A cozy life simulation game where players cultivate magical plants and befriend woodland creatures to restore a once-thriving enchanted garden.

works.title: Byte Bandits
works.description: A fast-paced top-down shooter where players hack and slash through cyberpunk-themed levels as a band of misfit hackers on a mission to take down an oppressive AI.

works.title: Timberfolk Tales
works.description: A resource management and storytelling game where players guide a village of anthropomorphic animals through seasonal challenges and community-building quests.

works.title: Luminaria
works.description: A visually stunning puzzle adventure where players manipulate light and color to awaken a sleeping world and piece together its lost history.

works.title: Synthwave Standoff
works.description: A neon-drenched arcade-style rhythm brawler where players fight enemies in sync with an electrifying synthwave soundtrack.

works.title: Pixelnomicon
works.description: A retro-styled RPG where players explore cursed ruins and use an in-game spellbook to create and customize their own magic system.

works.title: Skybound Saga
works.description: A whimsical airship exploration game where players travel between floating islands, trading goods, recruiting crew members, and battling sky pirates.

works.title: Fragments of Eden
works.description: A narrative exploration game where players uncover the secrets of a lost utopian society through environmental storytelling and first-person puzzles.

works.title: MechaForge Arena
works.description: A tactical mech combat game where players design and pilot custom robots in turn-based battles across a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

works.title: Dreamcatcher Chronicles
works.description: An adventure game where players navigate surreal dreamscapes to uncover hidden memories, confronting challenges based on emotional growth and self-discovery.
